title: To name the Department of Veterans Affairs community-based outpatient clinic in Youngstown, Ohio, as the Carl Nunziato VA Clinic.
official_summary: This bill designates the community-based outpatient clinic of the Department of Veterans Affairs in Youngstown, Ohio, as the Carl Nunziato VA Clinic.

summary.headline: A law renames a VA outpatient clinic in Youngstown, Ohio, after Carl Nunziato.
summary.what_it_does: This law officially names the Department of Veterans Affairs community-based outpatient clinic in Youngstown, Ohio, the Carl Nunziato VA Clinic. It does not change the clinic's services, staffing, or hours. The change is only a new official name.
summary.when_it_takes_effect: The law was enacted on January 5, 2021.
